Start Creating [图标][图标] [Toy lion model with broken mesh patches, before print repair][Repaired watertight toy lion model, ready for 3D printing] Printability [图标] Watertight Yes Volume 702.19 cm³ Holes 0 Non-manifold edges 0 AI Auto-Repair Born Printable, Not Patched Most AI models need manual cleanup before they'll slice. Meshy models come out watertight and manifold. A built-in printability check still scans every export and auto-repairs any edge cases before you slice. [Skeleton wolf model auto-split into color-coded printable parts] [Whole skeleton wolf miniature shown in the viewer before auto-split] Auto Split Print in Multi-Color, or Split to Fit Multi-color printing maps each texture to the right filament, with clean color boundaries. When a model is too complex, Auto Split breaks it into watertight parts, pre-arranged on the build plate. Straight to Your Slicer Export as STL, OBJ, or 3MF, then send models directly to OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, and more, ready for single- or multi-color printing.
